An AI support agent retrieves customer documents from a shared vector index. The retrieval filter accepts the tenant key proposed by the model instead of binding it to the authenticated user. Text inside retrieved documents can instruct the agent and is treated as executable direction. Tool servers decide access from arguments generated by the model rather than independently authorizing the caller. The same delegated bearer credential is forwarded unchanged to every MCP server. A background retry can execute a high-impact action after the human approval screen was declined. Traces retain complete prompts, tool arguments, customer records and credentials. MCP peers are accepted without authenticating the server or protecting message integrity. There is no recursion, token, cost or tool-call budget for an agent run.
